```{r}
calles_line <- readRDS("C:/M/parcial_geoC/data/processed/calles_line.rds")
```

```{r}
calles_linedup <- calles_line
st_geometry(calles_linedup) <- st_geometry(calles_line)  |>
    lapply(function(x) round(x, 0)) |>
    st_sfc(crs = st_crs(calles_line))
```

```{r}
calles_linered %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    highway %in% c("primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "trunk"),
    is.na(maxspeed)
  ) %>%
  with(table(name, highway))
```

```{r}


calles_per <- calles_linedup %>% 
  filter(grepl("Colón|Ameghino|Paraguay|Rocha|Yrigoyen|Justo", name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(name, highway, maxspeed)
```

```{r}
#Imputacion velocidades
calles_linedup <- calles_linedup |>
  mutate(
    maxspeed_imp = case_when(
      is.na(maxspeed) & grepl("Juan B. Justo|Ameghino|Paraguay|Colón|Rocha|Yrigoyen", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 60, 
      is.na(maxspeed) & highway == "residential" ~ 40, 
      !is.na(maxspeed) ~ as.numeric(maxspeed), 
      TRUE ~ 40)
    )
```

```{r}
#Longitud
calles_linedup <- calles_linedup |>
  mutate(
    longitud = st_length(geometry)
  )

summary(calles_linedup)
calles_linedup |>
  filter(longitud == 0)
filter(calles_linedup, longitud == units::set_units(0, "m"))

```
